business: Cascadia Climate Services, Inc. (Commercial & Residential HVAC Services)

expectedRedFlags: One-time strategic consulting: Unsupported. Payments to North Peak Consulting are level monthly amounts that begin before and continue after the claimed project window.
expectedYellowFlags: Owner vehicle & personal fleet expense: Partially supportable. $41,500 of the $84,000 TTM claim relates to two personally-titled vehicles; the remainder is operating fleet cost that continues post-close.
ERP implementation project: Supportable. Three sequential project invoices in Mar-May 2025 with no activity before or after; go-live confirmed in management Q&A.
Excess owner compensation: Partially supportable. Owner comp of $350,000 versus a $275,000 market replacement GM salary supports a $75,000 add-back, not $125,000.
Customer concentration: Largest customer, Elkhorn Property Group, is 18.7% of FY2025 revenue; top 5 are 64.4%.

Seasonality and net working capital swing: FY2025 monthly EBITDA ranges from $6,601 to $200,693; cash ranges from $1,696,088 to $2,303,034. The NWC peg must be set on a 12-month average, not a period-end snapshot.
groundTruth.notes: MML M&A Benchmark Deal DD-001: Cascadia Climate Services, Inc. (Commercial & Residential HVAC Services). Seller claims $1.59M EBITDA vs $1.26M buyer-supported ($333k overstatement).
